events.title: 🐻 New official Discord for the Yami Mura franchise + Key Giveaway!
events.summary: New official Yami Mura franchise Discord & Key Giveaway!Right now, our Discord server is emptier than a spooky abandoned village... so let's bring it to life!How to get your free key:Join the new official Discord server.Share a screenshot of yourself playing the demo in the designated channel.Link: DiscordThe first 60 people to do so will get a completely free game key at launch, plus an exclusive role. See you there!

events.title: 🐻 Yami Mura — Who is Bobby? Explained
events.summary: Who is Bobby?If you played the previous demo, you’ve probably already met Bobby. We received a surprising amount of alerts every time a player greeted him, and honestly… thank you for that.Bobby is the studio’s mascot, and also a very important part of our lives.Since he’s getting older and going through a difficult stage due to his age, we decided to make him part of the project forever.So every time you see Bobby in the game, that’s the real Bobby. 🐻
